notes: Clicking 1080p no longer slides back to 360p. A size change cancels the load that was running, and that cancellation can arrive as an error after the new size has already started - the tab read it as the new size being refused and walked one size down, twice, so a tap on 1080p ended on the 360p row. An error now counts only when the phone reports a real media error on the size that is actually playing.
When a size really is refused, the footer names the size and the codec the phone could not open, so a smaller picture is never a mystery.
A picture that is still fetching is not a picture that failed: a size that is loading, or that has buffered anything, keeps its time and its size instead of losing them.
